core_invariants.generation_audit_differs_from_admission_: Generation audit (search heuristics, traces, cost) never implies admission into certified substrate. Admission audit requires independent replay and cryptographic seal verification.
core_invariants.fail_closed_replay: Unregistered verifier IDs or unverified payloads are strictly rejected (ReplayStatus.REJECTED, ProofStatus.PROOF_GAP).
core_invariants.domain_neutrality: mapeogeo.proof contains only domain-neutral verification infrastructure. Domain theorem semantics reside strictly under mapeogeo.domains.mathematics.
